_provenance: Published from laquereric/iq@598e8b3d39cfab559d748fd8c78b369927b9d05b, Development/UseCase/UC_Mvi/sandbox.cid.json, so the seam's CID is fetchable outside a private repo (rule 10).
description: The sandbox seam: what the host BACK serves a workload FRONT across its VM boundary, over vsock (guest -> host, port 7000, CID 2), one JSON-RPC 2.0 request per line and one CPCP envelope back. A workload is answered only the operations its own manifests declare, and only with the caller Bearer the runtime issued at boot. Served by Development/UseCase/UC_Mvi/sandbox.py in laquereric/iq; registered in cpcp_registry, status proposed.
auth: Bearer, issued at boot and handed to the process in guest.process.start; never in the image

operations.result: {up: true, pod, operations, egress, durable, contract}
@graph of {@id, type, digest}: the inputs granted to this pod

params.url: string (required): under a producer the workload's dependency manifest declares

operations.result: {@id: iq:fetch:root/mvi/<pod>/<sha256>, url, status, content_type, digest, content, truncated?, location?}: the producer's answer, a 4xx or 5xx included

params.effect: object (required): JSON-LD held to the closed shape the workload's own CID names for this operation, citing in prov:wasDerivedFrom only inputs it was granted or fetched

operations.result: {@id, digest, operationId, receipt}; a repeated operationId replays the first

params.effect: object (required): held to its shape as for sandbox.effect.put
params.method: string (optional): POST (the default), PUT, PATCH or DELETE

operations.result: {sent: {@id, digest, method}, answer: {status, ...}, operationId, receipt}; a repeated operationId replays the first and is not sent again
